name: Dissector Honey
source:
Honey is a orphan child who has a peculiar like: the dissection. She is a serial killer who kills and dissect her victims. In this game, you control Honey to attract her victims and dissect them.

[From [url=https://hybrid-choko.itch.io/dissector-honey]itch.io[/url]]
